_doc: Trade routes / land paths between settlements, temples and stations. a, b = label names (routed at load by map-core.js prepEls: A* on the ½-res grid, bridges as edges, Muhl Flats avoided; see the TR block). pts = legacy 8 px A* polyline (image px), used only as a fallback when a pair cannot be routed. Names starting with @ are image-px points "@x,z" (user-drawn manual trails; snapped to the nearest passable cell, no auto-neighbour links). noAuto: node names that get no automatic nearest-neighbour trails (only the routes listed here).
